description:
Issue a Certificate of Conformance for a lot. It names the customer, spec and signer, lists the lot's
attached documents and points at the lot's record, so the buyer can check it has not been edited.
Refused for recalled lots, lots with open non-conformance reports, or altered histories. Manufacturers only.

location.description: Where it happened, e.g. 'Plant 2, Port Huron MI'
location.title: Location

specification.description: Drawing, standard or spec and revision, e.g. 'DWG A-12 rev C, ASTM A36'
specification.title: Specification

statement.description: Your own certification wording; a standard sentence is used if empty
statement.title: Statement

name: chainflow_coc_issue
title: ChainFlow: issue a Certificate of Conformance
